description: Jump Skill Ninjas are intelligent meta-skills — master orchestrators that route your requests to the most appropriate specialized skill from a curated library. Instead of manually searching through hundreds of individual skills, you simply describe your task and the Ninja Identifies specialized skills and Loads the full skill in context
